summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Stripe subscription integration (Stage 3) + verified Stage 1 & Stage 2 regression. All Stripe backend endpoints (8 tests) and frontend flows (7 tests) passed. All Stage 1 & 2 pages still render correctly.

design_issues.issue: Bottom nav tabs missing data-testid attributes (nav-home, nav-trips, nav-vehicle, nav-settings)
design_issues.note: Nav is visually present and functional, just missing test IDs for automated testing

Backend Stripe: GET /stripe/config returns correct structure (pk_test_, configured: true, 14 trial days, 3 plans)
Backend Stripe: POST /stripe/checkout creates session for all 3 plans (owner_op, small_fleet, mid_fleet)
Backend Stripe: POST /stripe/checkout returns 400 for invalid plan
Backend Stripe: POST /stripe/checkout returns 401 without auth
Backend Stripe: GET /stripe/subscription returns 200 (status: none)
Backend Stripe: POST /stripe/portal returns 400 without customer
Backend Stripe: POST /stripe/webhook returns 200 {received: true}
Frontend: Marketing page shows 'Pricing' link in nav
Frontend: /pricing page renders 3 plan cards (Owner-Op $29, Small Fleet $99, Mid Fleet $299) + 'Most popular' badge + Large Fleet contact sales card
Frontend: Subscribe when NOT logged in redirects to /login?next=/pricing
Frontend: Fleet admin subscribe redirects to Stripe checkout (https://checkout.stripe.com/)
Frontend: Driver subscribe shows toast 'Subscriptions are managed by your fleet admin' and stays on /pricing
Frontend: /app/billing shows empty state 'No active subscription' with 'View pricing' button
Frontend: Billing nav link present in admin sidebar
Regression: All Stage 1 & 2 backend endpoints still return 200
Regression: Marketing pages (/, /login, /forgot-password) render correctly
Regression: All 10 admin pages render (/app, /app/drivers, /app/vehicles, /app/trips, /app/maintenance, /app/alerts, /app/dashcam, /app/ifta, /app/profile, /app/waitlist)
Regression: All 5 driver PWA pages render (/driver, /driver/trips, /driver/vehicle, /driver/settings, /driver/profile)
Regression: Driver bottom nav has 4 tabs (Home, Trips, Truck, Settings)
